inputs.label: What to audit
inputs.help: Empty: everything the project can load. Name folders or skills to read only those; the report says what was left out.

inputs.label: Include your own files
inputs.help: Your personal instruction file, skills, prompt commands and playbooks. They aren't on a branch, so they are reported, never fixed.

inputs.label: Investigators at most
inputs.help: One per subject, sized to the project from its inventory: a small project gets one. Lower it to spend less.

inputs.label: Anything you already suspect
inputs.help: A rule you think is stated twice, a skill you find slow: the investigators check it first.

read.label: Investigation
read.goal: Collect the files of one subject each and read them against each other for contradictions and layout

investigator.label: Investigator
investigator.brief: Reads one subject across every file that touches it and lists each possible contradiction with both sides located

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.goal: Keep only the contradictions the exact lines prove

challenger.label: Challenger
challenger.brief: Rereads both sides of each contradiction at their exact lines and confirms, downgrades or drops it

report.label: Report
report.goal: Gather every finding into the chat report and answer the user's questions about it until the run ends

writer.label: Report writer
writer.brief: Writes the report shown in the chat and stays available to answer questions about any finding

fix.label: Fix
fix.goal: Apply only the fixes the user picked, on the run's branch, one commit per group

fixer.label: Fixer
fixer.brief: Moves and removes text exactly as picked, never rewording, and commits each group on its own

steps.label: List what loads, and when
steps.goal: Every item the project can load, measured, with its references, orphans and repeats

steps.label: Read the files against each other
steps.goal: Contradictions with both sides located, each checked against its exact lines, and each skill's layout

steps.label: Report in the chat
steps.goal: Counts by severity, then one sentence per issue, contradictions first

steps.label: You pick the fixes
steps.goal: One question per contradiction only you can settle, the mechanical fixes in groups, each layout as one yes or no

steps.label: Fix on the branch
steps.goal: Only what you picked, one commit per group, text moved and never reworded

steps.label: Check again
steps.goal: The numbers before and after, and every moved paragraph accounted for
